text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Haru Urara was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?
I'm not even that tired though?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can really take a nap...
I'm not... a kid anymore... *yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What was I doing again?
Umm...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Are there a bunch of fish swimming in the sky?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! A whole school of taiyaki!
Ahahaha! Gotta catch 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that was delicious!
So taiyaki really do swim through the sky, huh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea such an amazing place existed!
I have to go tell everyone right away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan, Urara-chan!
The race is still going on! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That moon is the goal line!
Hurry up, or you're gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? A footrace!?
Is that what this was!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then I gotta run fast!!
I definitely, definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If the moon is the goal, I gotta jump!
Urara JUMP!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I'm running in the sky!
So much fun! Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh! That's the finish line! I'm in first place!
Yay! Woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara dove into the finish tape.
In that instant, everything around went completely white—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fweh?
...Is this... school?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh!? For some reason, I'm bursting with energy right now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her energy, Haru Urara
left the infirmary full of pep.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Now all that's left is to run all the way to the moo—
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, what?!
They're falling straight out of the sky!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when it seemed to plummet from the sky all at once,
everything around turned stark whiteâ

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait... Is this school?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I think I just had a really scary dream...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Terrified by her dream, Haru Urara was unable to get enough rest.
